scenario: A workers' compensation adjuster processes an injury incident report: the medical entity extractor parses the injury narrative to identify diagnoses, severity, and functional limitations; the financial calculator computes the weekly indemnity benefit based on the claimant's pre-injury wage and the applicable wage replacement rate tier; the reporting skill generates a formal adjudication decision report with the approved benefit amount.
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses the injury report to produce structured entities including injury severity and diagnosis context → financial-calculator uses the severity tier to select a wage replacement rate and computes the weekly benefit amount from the claimant's pre-injury wage → reporting generates the adjudication decision document with the approved weekly payment.
